```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(knitr)
```

#### Function for making a table
```{r}
display_table <- function(file_name){
  f <- fread(file_name)
  f <- f %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c("sumlogReal","var(Perms)","mean(Perms)"))
  f %>% kable()
}
```

Load matched, random sets for WNT
```{r}

display_table("./randomset/1000perm.wnt.il6.jag.merged.P1.empp")

```

load matched, random sets for IL6 
```{r}
display_table("./randomset/il6.jag.draws_neff_all.merged.P1.empp")
```

load matched, random sets for WNT
```{r}
display_table("./randomset/wnt.jag.draws_neff_all.merged.P1.empp")
```
